_doc: Overhead chop. end = joint angles where the slam finishes; cock = how far the cocked pose is pulled back from it; jaw_open = sword cock angle; t_* = phase seconds (raise+reach, roll+cock, slam).

_help.end.lift: shoulder angle when the slam finishes (deg; more positive = arm further forward/down)
_help.end.elbow: elbow angle at the slam finish (deg; negative = forearm raised)
_help.end.wrist: wrist pitch at the slam finish (deg; positive = hand pointing down: sets how steep the sword ends)
_help.cock.lift_back: how far the shoulder is pulled back from the end for the cocked pose (deg): bigger = more arm drop during the slam
_help.cock.wrist_up: how far the wrist is pitched up from the end for the cocked pose (deg): bigger = sword more vertical when cocked
_help.jaw_open: how far the sword cocks up before the slam (0 shut .. 100 fully open)
_help.t_raise: seconds: rest -> raised and reached forward
_help.t_cock: seconds: roll and cock the sword up
